liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd95-03-17.soundcheck.sbd.17951.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 28 songs; 43 min; rated 3.25/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording lacks bass and stereo dynamic, sounding flat due to ear-monitor feed [13]
- **gd95-03-17.sbd.16057.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 164 min; rated 2.9/5 by 9 [3]. Said about its sound: Soundboard recording is crisp and enjoyable, contrasting with poor audience recordings [14]
- **gd1995-03-17.aud.bleich.91840.flac16**: audience recording; 18 songs; 166 min [6]. Said about its sound: Sporadic low-end over saturation attenuated; tape flips crossfaded with EQ and plugins added [6]
- **gd1995-03-17.142982.Boedicker.flac1644**: source not stated; 21 songs; 169 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Phil directs the band on playing the song; Garcia appears only near the end [13]
- High-energy opening with tight first set; Jerry happy and ripping it up [14]
- Listener attended with high school sweetheart; song brings back memories of important life times [15]
- Listener attended with high school sweetheart; song brings back memories of important life times [16]
- Jerry used a teleprompter on stage to help with lyrics during the performance [17]
- Phil sings loudly, warming up vocals before the song was played two nights later [18]
- Jerry sounds wiped out and plays a slide on this track [18]
- Drummers try to slow Jerry down twice before finally matching his fast tempo [18]
- Listener recalls many great times at the Spectrum between 1980 and 1995 [17]
- Garcia nearly absent and sloppy; band performance choppy, improving significantly the next night [19]
- 1995 shows less impactful for listener than mid-to-late 80s Spectrum performances [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd95-03-17.soundcheck.sbd.17951.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Marc Pujol; source: Rehersal - Phil's Ear Monitor Feed > Crew Member's Cassette Master (recorded inside venue) > 2nd Gen Cassette **see notes via Marc Pujol [1]
